def subsets_of(n):
    return list(range(1 << n))

def popcnt(m): return bin(m).count("1")

def is_downset(F, n):
    # hereditary: A in F, B subset A => B in F
    for A in F:
        s = A
        while s:
            lo = s & -s
            if (A & ~lo) not in Fset: return False
            s ^= lo
    return True

def max_intersecting(F, n):
    # exact maximum clique in the "disjointness-forbidden" graph:
    # G intersecting iff every two DISTINCT members intersect (weaker,
    # hence stronger, definition — includes |G|=1 vacuous case).
    idx = {A: i for i, A in enumerate(F)}
    m = len(F)
    adj = [0]*m
    for i in range(m):
        for j in range(i+1, m):
            if F[i] & F[j]:
                adj[i] |= 1 << j
                adj[j] |= 1 << i
    best = 0
    def bk(R, P):
        nonlocal best
        if not P:
            best = max(best, popcnt(R)); return
        if popcnt(R) + popcnt(P) <= best: return
        # pivot on highest-degree
        p = max(range(m), key=lambda v: popcnt(adj[v] & P)) if P else 0
        cand = P & ~adj[p] if False else P
        while cand:
            v = cand & -cand
            bk(R | (1 << v), P & adj[v])
            cand ^= v
            P &= ~(1 << v)

def require(cond, msg):

def hereditary_count(n):
    # bitmask enumeration of antichains over subsets of [n]; exact ints only
    masks = range(1 << (1 << n))
